decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of the granting of original permission 19/00087/FUL (23/10/2019).Reason: As required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside of the following times: 0800 hours to 2300 hours Monday to Saturday and 1000 hours to 2200 hours on Sundays.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to comply with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The noise and anti-vibration measures, as detailed in the email from Adam Beamish to Thomas Frankland dated 14 October 2019 at 12:37, shall be maintained at the site for the duration of the use hereby permitted.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to comply with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The premises shall be used only as a restaurant and/or a hot food takeaway and for no other purposes whatsoever.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to comply with policy D14 of the LondonPlan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Provision shall be made for commercial and domestic waste to be stored in suitable receptacles so as not to cause or be detrimental to the amenities of the locality.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to comply with policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Deliveries to the site shall not take place outside of the following times: 0800 hours to 2300 hours Monday to Saturday and 1000 hours to 1900 hours on Sundays.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to comply with policy DM14 of the London Plan 2016 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The rating level of the noise determined by the cumulative sound emissions of the plant hereby permitted shall be at least 5dBA lower than the existing background noise level at any given time of operation. The noise levels shall be measured or predicted 1m externally to any window at the nearest residential facade. Measurements and assessment shall be made according to British Standard 4142:2014.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to comply with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
